title: Guling Street Avant-garde Theatre
axis: +X follows the angled facade to the north, and +Z moves from the entrance toward the rear.
source: Named OpenStreetMap building 314806410 and Taipei City historic building register
identityStatus: Named OSM way 314806410 carries the theatre’s address, three-floor tag and Wikidata identity. The survey retains the five-point envelope and the distinctive northwest-facing clipped corner.

terrainContact.basis: Original elevation near the center of the former police station.

notes: The operator describes the original two-storey Japanese-style brick street block and three-floor rear workshop wing. Taipei’s rehabilitation record describes the Art Deco on both street-facing sides and preservation of the historic station. Peter Bronski’s cleared photograph establishes the ribbed corner, projecting balcony and grouped windows.
